question: Is the nuisance recall failure caused by spatial-process evidence, temporal-process evidence, their aggregation, or an invalid mapping from Pi5>=1 to a coherent-nuisance stratum?
diagnostics: nuisance-only spatial, temporal and combined score quantiles by exact Pi5
component pass rates at 0.55 by exact Pi5
combined pass rate by exact Pi2 and Pi5
target-only and target-coupled maxima for false-positive safety

interpretation_rules_prefrozen.coherent_stratum_definition_defect: Pi5=1 combined recall <0.50 while at least one larger Pi5 level has recall >=0.80; Pi5>=1 was too broad a latent definition of spatial coherence
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.spatial_representation_bottleneck: for genuinely high-Pi5 nuisance, temporal pass rate >=0.80 but spatial pass rate <0.80
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.temporal_representation_bottleneck: for genuinely high-Pi5 nuisance, spatial pass rate >=0.80 but temporal pass rate <0.80
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.aggregation_bottleneck: for genuinely high-Pi5 nuisance, both component pass rates >=0.80 but combined pass rate <0.80
interpretation_rules_prefrozen.no_retuning: diagnosis selects the failure branch only; it does not authorize threshold search or rewriting the failed validation result

claim_boundary: post-result development diagnosis only; no field-calibrated nuisance threshold claim
